text: Implemented native optional FirstLevelCompanionReview and JVM loading independently of fitted nuisance. Identified raw columns preserve missing values, original run samples, declared/unknown units and source receipts; absent/ambiguous tables, bad rows/numbers and changed input are explicit. Reads are bounded to 64 MiB and do not open BOLD payloads. Shared suite: 2 JVM and 2 Scala.js tests pass; JVM IO public test passes. Consumer verifies raw QC sample, missing state, source hash/export and same-size/same-mtime QC change refusal. Updated workflow README.
